page: Google Cloud Platform n4-highcpu-32 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the n4 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and features 32 vCPUs mapped to 16 physical Intel cores with hyperthreading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. The instance is provisioned with 64 GB of dedicated system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU accelerators.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities in memory bandwidth and multi-core execution. The instance achieves strong top-25% results in uncached large-block memory read and write operations, reaching 227.19 GB/sec and 104.22 GB/sec respectively. It also demonstrates strong performance in Geekbench multi-core testing, image processing, and PassMark CPU physics simulations. Single-core execution, database operations, and cryptography tasks perform within the average middle-50% range.

The underlying Intel processor supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and INT8 operations, which accelerate machine learning and vector math. The instance is well-suited for compute-bound workloads such as multi-threaded software compilation, image processing, static web serving, and lightweight large language model inference. Given its high compute-to-memory ratio, it offers resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for applications that prioritize raw processing power over large memory footprints.
